rationale.A: Kotkankatu/Tivolitie and Linnunlaulu, but 150 m on Aleksis Kiven katu (tram) and 100 m on Helsinginkatu in traffic; 3 lights
rationale.B: Same as A, starting via Viipurinkatu (180 m with tram rails)
rationale.C: No traffic: Tivolitie, then paths towards Töölönlahti and Baana; unsignalised Aleksis Kiven katu crossings; 3 lights; +1 min
rationale.D: 180 m on Viipurinkatu (tram), then Tivolitie, Linnunlaulu and Töölönlahti paths; 1 light; +2 min
rationale.E: No traffic; via the Olympic Stadium area and Töölönlahti; four unsignalised crossings; 2 lights
rationale.F: No traffic; Eläintarhanlahti shore and Kaisaniemi park to Baana; least roadside riding; 1 light; +3 min
rationale.G: Through Kallio streets and Hakaniemi; 230 m on Porvoonkatu (140 m tram); 7 lights
rationale.H: All bike path, no traffic, but ~700 m beside Aleksis Kiven katu; 2 lights; +5 min

notes: D saves 2 lights for 2 min. For calm, C at +1 removes A's tram-street traffic. F is a bit calmer at +3 min; whether that small extra gain is worth 2 more minutes is a judgement call.
